Notional four-channel reactor protection system

NuSCR requirements, a function-block design that implements them, the design as an OpenModelica model, C code generated from it, and a virtual system that runs the design on this page. Everything is checked against the requirements scan by scan.

How the package fits together

Read the folders in their numbered order. Each stage is generated from the one before by the scripts in tools/ and checked against the requirements.

Folders

What each folder holds and the one file to open first. Markdown files read best in VS Code's preview; the links below open them as text in the browser.

Virtual system

The four bistable processors (channels A–D) and the coincidence processor, executing the design scan by scan (50 ms per scan) in this page. Change an input, press a button or replay a scenario, and watch the channel trips, the 2-out-of-4 votes and the reactor trip initiation.

Trip functionABCD2 of 4

OK = normal, PRE = pre-trip alarm, TRIP = channel trip. OB operating bypass active, BYP trip channel bypass switch on. Select a row to see it in detail.

    Commands

    Run from the package folder. Python 3.10 or later; no other packages.

    Regenerate and check everything

    python -B tools/build_all.py

    Build the C simulator and run it

    python -B tools/build_c.py
4_code\build\rps_sim.exe run SYSTEM 5_simulation\scenarios\loss_of_flow_4ch.csv trace.csv
4_code\build\rps_sim.exe interactive SYSTEM

    Simulate the OpenModelica model

    OMEdit: File > Open Model/Library File > 3_case_tool\openmodelica\RPS.mo, then RPS.Scenarios > Simulate
python -B tools/run_openmodelica.py

    Compare the code with the requirements

    python -B tools/verify_c.py
python -B tools/verify_js.py
python -B -m unittest discover -s 6_verification/tests
    Generated by tools/render_start_here.py from the design and the verification reports; do not edit by hand.
